text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I head to a cafe during one of my days
off, and
there, I run into Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hm. Are you also here to rest your weary
bones?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I decide to sit a few seats away to avoid

disturbing her reading session, but just
as I begin
to settle in...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Cling, clang, cling...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...My, my.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
If it isn't the sovereign scoundrel herself.
This is
quite the chance meeting.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And you're... heh. The Dark Lord of
Destruction
or something or other, right?
Here to enjoy
yourself a little tea party,
it looks like.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I see you're a fan of Enlightenment era

philosophy, then? Or is that another one
of your
poser decorations you delude
yourself with?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh. The Duchess did mention your
astuteness. I
won't bother to refute your
claims.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
But it would be folly for you to disdain
me so.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Are you aware of how a performer
becomes a
masked phantom?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The answer lies in song.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
It lies also in costumes, lighting, and

arrangement. Each comes together to
provide a
stage upon which mere flesh
may transform into
an endless array of
colorful identities.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Stage settings are as cards, and the
more you
hold, the better. The greater
the hand, the more
vibrant the
performers and the stronger their

presence...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, fiction itself will become
fact!
Hehehe. Come now, take a seat!
See for yourself
the innumerable cards
at my disposal!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Watch as boundaries metamorphize...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: And you're taken to the far horizon...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Before arriving at the realm of Elysium!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: AAAHAHAHA! My cards are endless—infinite!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
My brilliance is everlasting! I am no
charlatan,
false with hollow lies!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I am an existence that forever shines on
the stage!
I am the contrapposto of
illusion and reality!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
With these cards in my possession, fact
and
fiction are both at my mercy!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Do you finally see me for who I am, O
ruler of
Sirius, bright star of the night?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Hahaha!
Hahaha! I did not
expect this!

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd find myself spellbound by a
mere
soliloquy. If I am the ruler of Sirius,
then you must
be a child of Bacchus
himself.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Do my words leave you dissatisfied? If
it's a fight
you want, I'm happy to oblige.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. I was just thinking how funny
it is that
we share admirers.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
And while it rubs me the wrong way to
be lumped
in with you, I don't see a
reason for us to fight.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Agreed. What I seek is the crown, not
the
adoration of those who would follow.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Nevertheless, it is not I who chooses who
raises
their wine glass to me. Should you
wish it, I will
gladly bind you once again
with my spell.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Hah. Go for it. While you're taken in by
the glass,
I'll kick the whole damn keg to
pieces.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I was only a bystander to their
exchange, but I
feel like I've had an
out-of-body experience. I try
to find the
words to describe what just happened,

but I only come up hopelessly short.
